reviewMethod: Read all 50 compiled entries, all 277 stored occurrences and full-case actor/source records; retested ordinary scene, Zen bend, title/catalogue/substring contamination, exact utterer prose, and the mandatory karma brief controls including reader-visible evidence and the 255/257 scope.

rows.priorFinding: REVISE — The repaired ordinary scene for 草鞋錢 is materially better, but the evidence paragraph still relies on reusable or anonymous prose (‘Travel, sandals, and payment occur together in the witnesses, which turn the expense of journeying into an accounting of what a visit actually gained’). It does not name the stored actor and work for each important inference, distinguish narrated/title/questioner frames, or report a concrete falsification boundary, so it still fails PROSE_HYGIENE questions 3, 8, 9, and 10.
rows.finding: The travel-expense meaning is clear, but Huangbo Xiyun is made the grammatical subject of “occur together”; each journey/payment inference and narrated versus spoken case remains unanchored.
